title: The Pilgrim's Grave
text: A fresh grave by the shrine road, the earth still loose, a pilgrim who did not make it. Their offering still lies on the mound, wrapped in clean cloth, untouched by animals. Something has been keeping the crows away.

options.label: Carry their offering on to the shrine.

outcomes.text: The priests bless you for it, and add a name to their prayers.

options.label: The devout prays at the fresh grave.

outcomes.text: The pilgrim's last wish, whispered from under the loose earth.
Good silver, and a heavy heart, and the crows come back the moment you leave.
